name: Gmail Token Auto-Refresh - All Accounts

payload.text: CRON EXPORT: Refresh mission-control/data/crons.json with latest cron jobs. Run: cron list, then write formatted output to the file, then git commit and push.

name: Weekly Memory Maintenance

payload.text:
⏰ Weekly Memory Maintenance

Execute: cd ~/.openclaw/workspace && ./scripts/memory-maintenance.sh

This will:
1. Check file sizes (WORKING.md, MEMORY.md)
2. Archive daily logs >30 days old
3. Generate review report
4. Git commit changes

After automated tasks, complete manual review:
- Review last 7 daily logs for lessons
- Extract insights to MEMORY.md
- Clean WORKING.md if needed

SOP: data/global/sops/memory-maintenance.md

description: Compacts memory files, archives old logs, generates review report

name: Bi-Weekly Memory Audit

payload.text:
🔍 Bi-Weekly Memory Audit (Clawson)

Perform memory health check:

1. Review memory/WORKING.md - is it current?
2. Review MEMORY.md - any outdated info to archive?
3. Check daily logs for patterns worth promoting
4. Compact any files over 50KB
5. Archive old daily logs (>14 days) to memory/archive/

Report summary to Steve:
- Files reviewed
- Context saved (tokens)
- Patterns promoted
- Recommendations

Keeps the system lean and compounds learning.

description: Health check on memory system, pattern extraction, file compaction

name: Drift Audit (Core Architecture)

payload.text:
🔍 Drift Audit — CORE ARCHITECTURE SPEC

Run: scripts/deploy/drift-audit.sh

Checks:
1. Canonical files integrity (canon/ directory)
2. Generated configs match canonical source (config/)
3. No forbidden changes (Kommo refs, unauthorized agents)
4. Directory structure correct
5. All cron jobs match manifest
6. No drift detected

Output: observability/drift-audit/audit-result-YYYYMMDD.json

Allowed auto-fixes (safe):
- Regenerate config/ from canon/
- Create missing directories
- Increment patch version

Manual flags (require review):
- Canon file content changes
- Breaking cron job changes
- New credentials
- Active code modifications

Alert Steve if flags found.

description: Daily drift audit, safe auto-fixes, manual flags for risky changes
